answer: Run collision checks on the work itself: each epoch, graders issue lightly mutated variants of the same task to different identities and compare the structure of what comes back. Clones sharing one inference pipeline return near-identical answers and get merged into a single reward share, while independent agents diverge naturally. No harbor of rented servers hides it: a ridge of a thousand wallets answering alike is billed as one, and the honest mesa of diverse workers keeps its full share.
